description: All hushell windows: taskbar, secondary-display bars (taskbar-s1..sN), hover preview card, live-wallpaper desktop, name dialog, task context menu, tray flyout, volume drop-up, start menu, lockscreen, wingroup list. Every window label must be listed here — tauri gates event listen() behind this list, and a missing label silently loses every listener (the secondary bars lost tasks/lang/close events exactly this way). The glob covers bars created on the fly by display hotplug.
